Hi all,

Quick follow-up from today’s cross-functional sync — we have a handful of outstanding exec asks and a small cascade of exceptions that need concrete owners and dates so we can lock the QBR deck by next Friday. I consolidated the list in the attached QBR_action_tracker.xlsx; please update the row for your item before EOD the due date listed below.

Top-of-mind items:
1) Model routing policy exec ask — timeline + mitigations (owner: Karthik). Due: Tue 2026-11-24. Deliverable: 1‑slide risk + rollback plan.
2) Pricing exceptions & committed discount table for Dedicated (owner: Marissa). Due: Mon 2026-11-23. Deliverable: table + recommended approver chain.
3) SLA exception for Acme — temporary credits & remediation plan (owner: Vivek). Due: Wed 2026-11-25. Deliverable: incident summary + proposed credit. Attached: SLA-exception-log.csv.
4) Security evidence requested by Acme audit — SOC2 artifacts and gap notes (owner: Olga). Due: Tue 2026-11-24. Deliverable: packaged evidence + redaction notes.
5) Consolidated exec slide deck (owner: me). Due: Thu 2026-11-26 noon. Please send finalized bullet(s) for your slide.
6) Infra perf numbers for Dedicated backlog — Karthik, this is blocking the run-rate slide; if numbers are delayed, call it out early.

Please be explicit in the tracker about open risks and whether you need help from Legal/Support/Eng. If an item will slip, flag it in the tracker and drop a one-line reason in the thread.

Attachments: QBR_action_tracker.xlsx, SLA-exception-log.csv

Thanks — small, focused deliverables here; appreciate quick turns.

Hannah
